hook: Your legs can walk without your spine's help.
title: A Robot Suit Makes Paralysed Legs Walk
description:
Exoskeletons like ReWalk use motors at the hips and knees so a person with a spinal cord injury can stand and take steps. Videos of it are easy to find online. Real technology that feels like science fiction.

#Shorts #Technology #Exoskeleton
comment_prompt: Would you wear one? Yes or no
